TWO-PAGER: PhD School
Starting as a PhD student marks the beginning of an exciting development path – full of curiosity, new friendships, and major academic challenges. At DTU Compute, PhD students become part of a vibrant and diverse community where we help each other grow – both as researchers and as individuals. We have a setup to support PhD students – whether they have questions about research, everyday life, or simply need good advice, we are here to help.
Dive into the two-pager and gain insight into our PhD School
